title: Lacks merit in finish- better used as insert..
text:
Lacks merit in finish- better used as insert... Sold as a comforter- this is more conducive to a duvet insert. This lacks the overall presentation one expects in a finished look.. and the more it’s in use- material becomes wrinkled and disheveled.

Ordered queen in charcoal gray- at $39 this is a higher price point. The seams feel rushed or careless as they’re stitched a bit crooked, x2 ends still had 3” straggle string that wasn’t secured off or clipped. We also had a few threads strewn loosely about the comforter. It’s as if this needs a better quality control before sending.. seller take note!

Fabric is a nice, soft to the touch material.. It has a slight sheen providing an almost “cooling effect.” Overall stuffing is lightweight however.. it is well dispersed to provide an even warmth.

Overall- for your price point this is best used as the duvet insert and not the finished top layer. Materials used are of good quality- its lacking in the finishing touches.. the touches that will help to give this longevity. Hoping this info can help your decision- stay safe and warm everyone!
